stalls.summaryZh: 台式炸雞皮薄酥脆、肉汁多，口味偏重但不死鹹；用餐時段常排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: Taiwanese fried chicken with thin, crisp skin and juicy meat; seasoning is on the heavy side but not overly salty. Queues at mealtimes.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜台東夜市最強Top 3
輕旅行｜13間台東觀光夜市美食推薦
Dcard美食板｜台東五樣觀光客必吃美食

foodsEn: Mixed grilled pork gua bao with egg
stalls.summaryZh: 炭烤肉片夾進軟刈包，可選原住民鹹豬肉，配蛋、酸菜與花生粉；個頭大，偶有烤得太焦。
stalls.summaryEn: Charcoal-grilled pork in a soft bun, including indigenous-style salted pork, with egg, pickled greens and peanut powder. Big portion; sometimes a little charred.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜台東夜市最強Top 3
輕旅行｜13間台東觀光夜市美食推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 六十多年手工湯圓老店，剉冰便宜大碗、紅豆綠豆煮得軟；有部落客覺得湯圓偏硬。
stalls.summaryEn: A 60-plus-year shop with handmade rice balls; shaved ice is cheap and generous with soft-cooked beans, though one blogger found the rice balls firm.

sources.title: 輕旅行｜13間台東觀光夜市美食推薦
Dcard美食板｜台東五樣觀光客必吃美食

stalls.summaryZh: 小塊臭豆腐炸得酥脆、中間塞滿醬料並加九層塔，沒有內用座位。
stalls.summaryEn: Small cubes fried crisp and stuffed with sauce and basil; no indoor seating.

sources.title: 輕旅行｜13間台東觀光夜市美食推薦
Dcard美食板｜台東五樣觀光客必吃美食

stalls.summaryZh: 夜市裡攤位最大的東山鴨頭，滷後油炸帶麥芽甜香，適合當下酒菜；有人覺得鴨翅外皮偏硬。
stalls.summaryEn: The biggest Dongshan duck-head stall in the market, braised then fried with a maltose glaze; good with beer, though one blogger found the wings tough.

sources.title: 輕旅行｜13間台東觀光夜市美食推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 比一般章魚燒大顆，外皮煎得香，內餡有花枝、蝦子、起司、玉米等。
stalls.summaryEn: Bigger than standard takoyaki with a crisp shell, filled with squid, shrimp, cheese and corn.

sources.title: 輕旅行｜13間台東觀光夜市美食推薦
食尚玩家｜台東夜市最強Top 3

stalls.summaryZh: 雞排大到跟臉差不多，用炭火保溫，外酥多汁，可撒梅子粉、請老闆切塊。
stalls.summaryEn: A face-sized cutlet kept warm over charcoal, crisp and juicy; add plum powder and ask for it cut up.

stalls.summaryZh: 酥皮式蚵仔煎，蚵仔不算多；部落客較推薦蝦仁煎。
stalls.summaryEn: Crispy-style oyster omelet with a modest amount of oysters; the blogger preferred the shrimp version.
